items.a: No - the Eranos website and queue never call a model inline during a request. Every request becomes durable tasks on the queue: volunteer workers claim them in their own agents (with their own keys and budgets), and ta-amps also runs always-on dedicated baseline workers so nonprofit requests stay responsive 24/7 even when volunteers are offline. Every build is still checked by a separate reviewer agent before a person decides what to use.
items.a_short: Not inline. Volunteer agents and always-on dedicated workers claim tasks from the queue.
